title: P15.10-C R2: fenced authority closure — claimed-version commit guard, guarded review commit, absolute lease lifetime at the canonical validation boundary
description: R2 remediation on PR #87 (BASE 0e27bc6ee236d82633d4aee321ba9cd264adc0c3) closing residual F1 findings, all CONFIRMED by pre-patch repro tests. F1.1: driver authorityGate checked only lease state/fence/expiry + evaluate().effective, so PAUSE->RESUME mid-await produced an effective policy at version V+2 that was NOT the claimed authorization. Fix: scheduler.assertLeaseAuthority(handle) — narrow read-only assertion re-proving state, fence, worker/boot, token, generation, checkpoint, expiry, absolute lifetime, and captured policy_version/terms_digest/owner/objective_version pins through the single currentLease path (no parallel validator); authorityGate calls it first, refusal -> DRIVER_AUTHORITY_LOST. F1.2: commitReview's own store.immediate (receipt + optional strategy revision + anchors) had no guard — guard now fires FIRST inside that txn (forwarded from runReview input); revoke between CEO decision commit and review commit rolls back every review side effect; deterministic zero-model checkpoints equally guarded; manual callers unchanged. F1.3: renew() stamped expires_at=now+60s past absolute lifetime and currentLease never checked lifetime — post-deadline settle/assert passed. Fix: absolute lifetime (started_at+max_lifetime_ms) enforced inside currentLease for renew/settle/assert; expires_at clamped at deadline. TTL 60s, heartbeat 20s, claim-bound and P15.10-B defaults unchanged. R2-F1a..j prove: pause->resume mid-await zero decision, terms drift blocked, stale-fence assert/renew/settle blocked, review rollback after revoke with legit decision, no strategy on authority loss, deterministic checkpoint guarded, no post-deadline extend/settle, two-connection fencing, manual regression. No merge, no deploy, driver opt-in OFF.
